homeStatement: On August 26, 2026, a glacier break sent floodwater through Nepal. There are 1,000+ dead, 3,900+ missing, and 590 foreigners from 39 nations among those affected. From Kipsaraman, West Pokot Border, we stand with Nepal. Ubuntu teaches us: I am because we are. Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam teaches us: the world is one family. We are gathering for food, shelter, medicine and rescue — with 90% of every gift sent to the Nepal Red Cross, and a transparency update each Friday.
